Bangkok day two

Jan 24, 2025

The next day we visited the Bangkokian Museum, which was quite impressive. The building dates back to the 1930s.

Then we also visited the Nielson Hayes Library. This was free to enter, but videos and pictures not allowed.

For lunch we went to the Michelin-starred Sri Trat Restaurant and Bar that serves the best Thai cuisine! We had a great time there.

We also visited Restaurant Ruen Urai for dinner. We didn’t wait long and the service was excellent as usual in Thailand.

And what are the chances to see my colleague in Thailand at the same time!
